raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Rows from the new 'v2' collector have timestamps 6 hours ahead of the 'legacy' collector, most likely UTC versus local UTC-6. In the samples, v2 rows interleaved by txn_id show 12:0x while their legacy neighbours show 06:0x. Late-evening v2 transactions therefore spill into 00:00-06:00 of the next day, which creates the phantom 2026-01-19 rows and the out-of-hours rows on 2026-01-18. The fix assumes the offset is a constant 6 hours, inferred from the samples only and not from any change note.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
